name: Stackelberg competition
summary: Duopoly quantity-competition where one firm commits first and the other best-responds.
rules_text: There are two firms: Leader (1) and Follower (2). A common inverse demand function P(Q) where Q=q1+q2, and cost functions C1(q1), C2(q2) are common knowledge. Leader chooses a non-negative quantity q1 and commits to it. Follower observes q1 then chooses q2. Payoffs are profits: Pi = P(q1+q2)*qi - Ci(qi). The game ends after both quantities are chosen. Higher profit is better; equilibrium is found by backward induction using the follower's best response.
rating_reason: Leader-follower sequential quantity game, pure strategic numeric choice.
